about: Small synthetic documents diff_engines.py rebuilds through the Python and the Rust engine. Feature shapes are taken from sidecar/tests (test_smoke, test_fullstack, test_body_binding, test_profile_orientation). Ordered by the port: primitives, sketch extrudes, booleans, blends, shell, revolve, patterns, holes, loft, sweep. Every one builds cleanly on the Python engine, or fails the way its expectError says (diff_engines.py --python-only).
